feeds.title: bpHope Blog
feeds.description: Collection of posts written with heartfelt honesty by a group of bloggers from around the world, with each providing their own unique perspectives on living with bipolar disorder. Our bloggers write on issues that reflect their experiences and knowledge of living with bipolar disorder and address a range of topics, including relationships, treatment, symptoms (mania, depression, anger, hypersexuality, impulsivity, sleep), stigma, parenting, and more.

feeds.title: International Bipolar Foundation Blog
feeds.description: International Bipolar Foundation focuses on mental health awareness, in addition to education, resources, and supportive connections for all who are touched by bipolar disorder. They also highlight and honor the multitude of remarkable contributions that those living with bipolar disorder continue to offer.

feeds.title: Be Your Own Light
feeds.description: This blog is written by Eleanor Segall. Diagnosed with bipolar 1 disorder (a mood disorder) at 16, and now in her twenties, she blogs about what has helped her in recovery and tries to help others too.

feeds.title: The Secret Life of a Manic Depressive
feeds.description: Seaneen Molloy's 'The Secret Life of a Manic Depressive' is about mental health and activism in the wake of the writer's 2007 hospital stay for bipolar disorder. Follow to keep up with her latest stories and interesting updates.

feeds.title: The Bipolar Battle Blog
feeds.description: I was diagnosed with bipolar disorder, back in 1999. Since then, I've been ashamed and kept it my secret. However, I made it my mission to be as proactive as I could to fight for my health. Recently, coming out of the shadows, I decided to create a blog called The Bipolar Battle. I want to empower those afflicted with bipolar disorder to live the life they deserve to live.

feeds.title: Jennifer Marshall Blog
feeds.description: Jennifer Marshal writes about living with bipolar and mental illness through her blog and openly talks with her kids about mental health.

feeds.title: CREST.BD Blog
feeds.description: This bipolar blog shares the latest findings and insights from CREST.BD's research and knowledge exchange. CREST.BD is a multidisciplinary collaborative network of researchers, healthcare providers, people living with bipolar disorder, their family members and supporters.

feeds.title: Bipolar India
feeds.description: Bipolarindia, the nation's first online community set up by a Bipolar for Bipolar Disorder and Depression. The Resource providers who interact on one common platform towards one goal: Lightening the burden of Bipolar and Depression.

feeds.title: Not Quite Right
feeds.description: I'm living proof that a bipolar life does not have to mean craziness on one end and enervation on the other. Let me give some insight on my bipolar life, especially as I take it day by day.

feeds.title: purplepersuasion Blog
feeds.description: Charlotte Walker's Purple Persuasion is a mental health blog by a writer who has been dealing with bipolar disorder for more than 25 years. She writes, 'While I want this blog to have a wide reach in order to connect with other people in similar situations, it remains my space for exploring what it is like to have a serious mental illness.'

feeds.title: Bipolar Me Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Janet Coburn a freelance writer/editor with bipolar disorder, type 2. For many years, I was diagnosed with unipolar depressions, but the new diagnosis fits me better and my new meds are keeping me much more on the level. I write about mental health issues, including talk therapy, medication, books, bullying, social aspects, and public policy, but mostly my own experiences.

feeds.title: This Girl's Got Curves
feeds.description: Hi! Welcome to my blog! This is really meant more as an online journal and possibly some sort of testimonial to the struggles of living with mental illness. It's going to be all kinds of dark and ugly but I hope also a little funny and informative as well.

feeds.title: Write into the Light
feeds.description: The inspiration for those with Mental Illness.

feeds.title: Bipolar Creatives
feeds.description: Bipolar Creatives is dedicated to celebrating the artistic voices of people everywhere with bipolar. Our disorder unites us; our creativity defines us.

feeds.title: The Bipolar Buzz Blog
feeds.description: Alaina Raquel is a Ph.D. dropout living with Bipolar disorder and anxiety. Through this blog, she talks about her mental health journey and recovery.

feeds.title: Bipolar Happens Blog
feeds.description: Julie A. Fast is the author of several books about life with bipolar disorder. On her blog, she writes about how to best manage bipolar disorder. Topics include actionable and positive ways to keep going, tips for healthcare professionals, and what to do if you've just been diagnosed.

feeds.title: Being Lydia!
feeds.description: I have had many health struggles in my 50 years. I have suffered from depression and bipolar; however, in the last few years, I have learned how to control the illness instead of it controlling me.

feeds.title: Pax Nortona A Blog by Joel Sax
feeds.description: Mr. Sax is an advocate for bipolar sufferers has become active in the Depressive and Bipolar Support Alliance. Articles of his have appeared in the OC Weekly.

feeds.title: Rethinking Bipolar
feeds.description: This site will help you look at bipolar from various perspectives and see what it really means to people. I hope we can change attitudes-toward and the treatment-of, those who struggle with emotional distress. Our main aim remains to help people think differently about bipolar disorder, hence 'Rethinking Bipolar'.

feeds.title: Palestine WILL Be Free Blog
feeds.description: Samina Raza was diagnosed with bipolar 1 disorder in 1985. With this blog, she wants to tell a story and to help other people with this illness, or any other mental illness.

feeds.title: So Bipolar Blog
feeds.description: Mehri Coulter is a 32 years old stay-at-home mother diagnosed with bipolar disorder. Describes how it has helped in shaping her into the woman she is today.

feeds.title: Insights From A Bipolar Bear
feeds.description: Just a guy sharing the wacky world of bipolar disorder, the humbling experience of getting in shape and some random thoughts sprinkled in.

feeds.title: Bipolar And Successful
feeds.description: Amy, is an author shares Bipolar Success & tricks of the trade.

feeds.title: Tessa Can Do It
feeds.description: Teresa (Tessa) Smeigh has bipolar disorder (mental), Fibromyalgia (nerves), degenerative disc disease (spine), and arthritis (joints). Despite that she is active in Mental Health Advocating and she has also been interviewed by blogs and had other posts published on many different blogs.

feeds.title: My Loud Whispers of Hope
feeds.description: Sharing my story openly and honestly about living with my Bipolar Disorder 1 and creatively filling my posts and pages with humor, education, pain, failure, success, loneliness, shame, stigma, perseverance, hope, faith, and love.

feeds.title: RosieSmrtiePants
feeds.description: The author shares his thoughts about bipolar disorder and about mental illness.

feeds.title: Bipolar Whispers
feeds.description: An author is a Mental health blogger with Bipolar, PTSD, OCD and Anxiety Survivor. Bipolar Whispers blog is for the person wondering if they are alone. For the person wondering 'How can I possibly get through this'. For the person newly diagnosed. For the person who has been diagnosed for a long time. For the person not yet diagnosed. For the person with multiple diagnoses.

feeds.title: BipolarBrave - Because I am Fearfully And Wonderfully Made
feeds.description: Through BipolarBrave blog you will learn about the signs and effects of bipolar disorder and gain insight into a world that exists despite the ignorance and unseen damage it does to so many authored by Katie R. Dale who is a former bipolar patient.

feeds.title: Our Lived Experience
feeds.description: Our Lived Experience is a community where South Africans affected by bipolar disorder share their stories, please contact us if you'd like to take part. If you're a South African bipolar blogger, please get in touch so that we can list your blog.

feeds.title: Bipolar, Unemployed & Lost
feeds.description: This blog is to help people who have mental illnesses or interested in mental health authored by a mental health blogger at Bipolar, Unemployed Lost.

feeds.title: Winning with Bipolar
feeds.description: An author is a middle-aged Certified Peer Specialist winning the battle with bipolar disorder one day at a time. He document this Winning with Bipolar blog to share his experience, strength, and hope.

feeds.title: Life Conquering Blog
feeds.description: Life Conquering is a blog designed to use my experiences with bipolar to encourage and educate readers as well as to glorify God.

feeds.title: Bipolar Tapestry~Poetic Thoughts
feeds.description: Nicole Moncada is an Aspiring writer, Proud Mother of the worlds greatest Son who is Type 1 Diabetic and has Aspergers, Survivor, a bit broken, Working on restoration through prayer and faith. PTSD, Bipolar type 1 Speaker/Educator for Mental Illness.

feeds.title: bpnurse
feeds.description: I'm a registered nurse and writer who also happens to be street-rat crazy. I was diagnosed with bipolar disorder at the age of 53 and here, I'll share the lumps and bumps of a late-life journey toward sanity. It's not easy being bipolar in a unipolar world; let's figure it out together.

feeds.title: A Bipolars Reality
feeds.description: I am a Canadian woman living in America. After 10 years diagnosed me with Bipolar 1, Social Anxiety and Agoraphobia none of the medicine worked. Recently thanks to a Mr. Stephen Fry I decided to accept my diagnosis and write about how I felt on a daily basis. Thus this blog was born.

feeds.title: Celtcoch
feeds.description: Red Celt is a writer, photographer, artist, and teacher in South Wales, UK. She has Bipolar, depression, anxiety, and OCD.

feeds.title: bipolarfanatic
feeds.description: Author had Bipolar disorder, type I, with psychotic features. This is my diagnosis and often times what dictates my life. It's hard for me to share feelings in the real world, but I can somehow find the words on 'pen and paper.'

feeds.title: Living with Bipolar Disorder
feeds.description: I am a vocal advocate for mental health education and extremely outspoken about the stigma associated with mental disorders and illness.

feeds.title: L i f e be IN it!
feeds.description: An Author is a survivor of Bipolar Disorder. The blog's main purpose is to document and discuss the challenges author was facing.

feeds.title: Revenge of Eve
feeds.description: A journey through recovery guided by a broken compass.

feeds.title: The Mental Refuge Blog
feeds.description: Anxiety, Bipolar Disorder, Depression, PTSD, and Schizophrenia Support for Christian Women.

feeds.title: Bipolar Mums
feeds.description: Bipolar Mums founder, Mariska Meldrum, is a mum of three and wife. Two years later, she experienced her first acute manic episode and was diagnosed with Bipolar Disorder Type 1. Initially devastated, this diagnosis did not stop Mariska from pursuing her dream. She founded Bipolar Mums because she 'doesn't know any other mums with Bipolar' and has a passion for encouraging women in their daily live

feeds.title: martinupfold
feeds.description: I am Martin Upfold and I am a father, husband, army veteran, student of photography and citizen journalist. Dealing with bipolar and depression, tackling it head on. What I do to cope with my situation is to do photography and occasionally blog about it.

feeds.title: Bipolar survivor
feeds.description: Anne Cain is an Advocate & Blogger for Mental Health especially Bipolar Disorder, & a Volunteer at The Humane Society of Southwest Missouri. This blog is to help people who have or care for someone with mental illness.

feeds.title: My Side of the Pole
feeds.description: I'm a 32 year old married woman who has been dealing with Bipolar disorder since the age of 14. This is all about my life, diagnoses, and treatments. I hope that others with Bipolar Disorder or PTSD can relate to my blog and find it helpful.

feeds.title: Apparently I'm Bipolar
feeds.description: An author is 31 year old woman with a four year old daughter with bipolar disorder describes her ups and downs through this blog.

feeds.title: That bipolar feel
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to talking about bipolar disorder!. Use this space to talk about some stuff you've been struggling with or you're proud of as well as ask for advice.

feeds.title: illuminated irises
feeds.description: Keep up with articles from Musical melody.

feeds.title: The Bipolar Mama
feeds.description: Lauren Kocher is an author and a mother of two boys, wife, roller derby girl with bipolar disorder. She shares her every day with mental illness to help end stigma.

feeds.title: Our Bipolar
feeds.description: At Our Bipolar, I tell stories about how my life has been shaped by bipolar, in hopes of reducing the stigma of mental illness

feeds.title: Bipolar Advantage Blog
feeds.description: The Mission is to help people with depression or bipolar disorder shift their thinking and behavior so they can lead extraordinary lives.

feeds.title: Blooming Mind Press
feeds.description: Hannah Blum is an author with bipolar 2 disorder. And also works as a blogger for the mental health organization HealthyPlace and has experience as a mental health advocate with organizations such as the National Alliance on Mental Illness (NAMI). This blog describes her journey.

feeds.title: Living with Bipolar: A Dancer's Tale
feeds.description: My name is Bridget Zhang and I am bipolar. I am also a dancer. This blog is to voice my own mind and maybe others can relate. I want to raise an awareness to the world about Bipolar Disorder. So many people know what it is but they don't know what it is like everyday for the person who has it.

feeds.title: Natasha Tracy Blog
feeds.description: Natasha Tracy is a bipolar expert, speaker, author and a person living with bipolar disorder. Read her Bipolar Burble blog for more on mental illness.

feeds.title: Bipolar Bandit
feeds.description: The blog covers topics on bipolar disorder, mental illnesses, mental health advocacy, and more. Michelle was diagnosed with bipolar disorder 35 yrs ago and hopes to educate, offer hope and inspire readers through her blog.

feeds.title: That bipolar feel when...
feeds.description: A blog dedicated to expressing and sharing relatable experiences for people with bipolar disorder.

feeds.title: Uniting Expertise in Law
feeds.description: Raeyn/Virginia is a 30-something mother to two, wife to another, and slave to two feline masters labouring under that fun old ball and chain known as Bipolar II. She felt that sharing her experiences with bipolar would be the best use of blog here.

feeds.title: Lit with Fire
feeds.description: A librarian's thoughts about living with MS bipolar and drugaddiction.

feeds.title: Bipolar News From Medical News Today
feeds.description: The latest bipolar research from prestigious universities and journals throughout the world.
